title: GetPromiseETA · courier, PBA used
desc: Order 12345612 is inside the 25% PBA rollout (bucket 12). PBA 185 at 1260 min beats the legacy seed 195 at 1500 (ratio 0.84), so PBA wins; the internal side (195, pickup 18:00 + 30 min buffer) is kept for the audit row.

title: GetPromiseETA · courier, outside rollout, internal wins
desc: Order 12345681 is outside the rollout (bucket 81). PBA is fetched for observation and its raw top 185 is filtered by serviceability, so the winner is 195 (REJECTED_OUTSIDE_ROLLOUT). The TAT_ADHERENCE candidate 287 wins the re-rank; the seed 195 does not. Internal and allocation dispatch are both 19:00.

title: GetPromiseETA · courier, PBA rejected TAT too high
desc: Order 12345614 is in rollout (bucket 14). PBA 185 at 4800 min against legacy 195 at 1200 gives ratio 4.0, which is rejected (threshold is inclusive). The internal re-rank keeps 195.

title: GetPromiseETA · courier, NO_PARTNER chain halt
desc: No reference id, so the PBA fetch is skipped (NOT_FETCHED). Neither the legacy list nor PBA has a candidate, so the chain halts: SUCCESS with no partner and no times; shadow and audit are NOT_REACHED.

title: GetPromiseETA · courier, PBA cache read degraded
desc: The PBA partition read failed. The allocator returns an empty answer with a nil error, so the record keeps cache_read_failed=true and decision_detail CACHE_READ_DEGRADED. TAT_ADHERENCE 195 wins. The audit row reads PBA_NOT_DELIVERABLE, not PBA_ERROR, which is bug B4 in doc 17.

title: GetPromiseETA · courier, partner-adherence lane
desc: Lane 22:243122 is on the partner-adherence allowlist, so candidates come from LMS (source PARTNER_ADHERENCE). Seed 185 is first in SK order; the re-rank picks 195 (score 1302 vs 1327). PBA is fetched outside the rollout (bucket 64) and returns no candidates.

title: GetPromiseETA · SDD hyperlocal, partner selected
desc: sdd_enabled header turns SDD on for lane 22 (CHANGED_TO_TRUE). The pincode mapping gives partner 476; today pickup 14:00 and the 300 min record TAT give delivery 19:00. The rollout is not evaluated.

title: GetPromiseETA · SDD default TAT
desc: SDD is on but no hyperlocal config matches, so the default 1440 min TAT is returned with partner 0. No pickup, no dispatch, no delivery time; the schedule is skipped with NO_PARTNER.

title: GetPromiseETA · lane not serviceable, pre-OP
desc: Pre-OP call on a lane the master marks not serviceable and the cache agrees with. The gate refuses the request with LANE_NOT_SERVICEABLE; no branch runs, so shadow and audit are NOT_REACHED.

error.message: pincode is not serviceable from this warehouse

title: GetPromiseETA · validation error
desc: warehouseProcessingTime is missing. Validation fails before enrichment, so the lane, branch and times stay empty; the record still carries the caller and the request as received.

title: GetPromiseETA · post-OP custom ETA, unserviceable lane
desc: eta_context=post_op projects the ETA although the lane is not serviceable (PROJECTED_POST_OP_UNSERVICEABLE). PBA is switched off, so its fetch is only for observation; serviceability is SKIPPED_POST_OP. TAT_ADHERENCE 287 wins.

title: GetPromiseETA · pharmacist candidate error, CHAIN_ERROR
desc: The legacy pharmacist lookup fails in the candidates stage. Per gap G1 the record keeps the partial state: the PBA result is already in (served, 185 at 1260), but no decision, dispatch or delivery is produced, and audit and shadow are NOT_REACHED. The error response carries no times.

title: HARD allocation · LMS rollout, PBA selected, edit allowed
desc: Order 9876501 is in the 20% LMS rollout (bucket 1). PBA picks 185 at 1260 min with the drop buffer; the COD edit-order is allowed for 185 (static set), so the opposite-mode PREPAID call runs too. READY_TO_DISPATCH because package 181 and invoice 187 are set (order is 66).

title: HARD allocation · PBA not deliverable, legacy partner
desc: Order 9876502 is in rollout (bucket 2). LMS says NOT_DELIVERABLE, so the legacy ClickPost-matched partner 287 is used (ADHERENCE_MATCH). Order is 66 ORDER_CONFIRMED; the trigger is the AWB_RETRY path.

title: HARD allocation · all LMS partners excluded, legacy
desc: Order 9876503 is in rollout (bucket 3) but prepaid, so no edit-order. Both LMS partners are on the excluded list, so the decision is ALL_PARTNERS_EXCLUDED and legacy 287 ships. The payment mode is sent as UNSPECIFIED (bug 11). Status 317 is DOCTOR_CONFIRMED.

title: HARD allocation · outside rollout, shadow LMS call
desc: Order 9876537 is outside the rollout (bucket 37). The shadow LMS call runs and returns NOT_DELIVERABLE, so the true reason is PBA_NOT_DELIVERABLE in lms.pba. The event still reads OUTSIDE_ROLLOUT, and selected_source is INTERNAL with legacy 195 (bugs 5 and 12).

title: HARD allocation · legacy ClickPost fallback, surface retry
desc: Order 9876555 is outside the rollout with shadow disabled, so no LMS call (mode OFF). The adherence rows come from MySQL and do not match a ClickPost preference. The air call returns no partner, the surface retry finds 287, and selection goes through CLICKPOST_FALLBACK. Order 58 is PAYMENT_PENDING.

title: HARD allocation · SDD, pincode mapping, payment pending
desc: Order 9876506 is SDD. The pincode mapping gives partner 476, which is in the SDD edit-order set; the COD order is not restricted, so CP_EDIT_APPLIED. Order 58 is PAYMENT_PENDING. ClickPost and LMS are not called.

title: HARD allocation · failure, pincode not serviceable
desc: ClickPost answers 200 with pincodeServiceable=false on the primary air call. The TechnicalException is rewrapped as ContractException, the outcome is FAIL_PINCODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE, and the surface retry is not attempted.

title: HARD allocation · no package tracking
desc: The order has no package tracking row, so the flow stops at the gate (NO_PACKAGE_TRACKING). The outcome OK_NO_PACKAGE still gets a record, with the package and pincode blocks empty.

title: HARD allocation · failure, no schedule ids
desc: LMS schedule call is empty and the MySQL fallback is empty too, so there are no schedule ids. The whole TAT block is skipped and the surface retry returns no partner: FAIL_NO_PARTNER with cause NO_SCHEDULE_IDS. Nothing is emitted (EXCEPTION). The PAYMENT pending mark still runs before the throw (bug 19).
